offering_description.value: Sells business management software and digital marketing services to small and medium-sized businesses. Products are sold mainly by direct sales teams and online, and delivered largely as monthly subscriptions.

primary_products.value: business management software; websites; online listings; print directories

primary_services.value: digital marketing; search engine optimization; social media management; reputation management

customer_segment.value: B2B: small and medium-sized local service businesses, such as home services, healthcare and legal practices

end_markets.value: small business services; home services; healthcare; legal; retail

revenue_model.value: subscription: monthly software and marketing service plans paid by small businesses; advertising: print and digital directory advertising purchased by businesses; service fees: setup and managed marketing services for business customers

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: business management software platform, sold to small and medium-sized businesses; service provider: outsourced marketing and advertising services, sold to small businesses

geography_served.value: US national: Nationwide across the United States

specialization.value: related lines: business software, digital marketing services and directory advertising for small businesses

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: in-house sales representatives selling to small and medium-sized businesses; online: digital sign-up and self-service purchasing of software and marketing plans

regulatory_exposure.value: low: Only normal business rules, such as advertising, consumer protection and data privacy laws
